wrong.why: The Hebrew gives 'sons of Shechaniah' and 'sons of Parosh' as separate groups, with a paragraph mark between them, and does not make Shechaniah a descendant of Parosh.
The Shephatiah of EZR 8:8 is recorded as shephatiah-10 (the ancestor whose sons were eighty males with Ezra), not shephatiah-5 of EZR 2:4.
Zebadiah is one of the sons of Shephatiah in EZR 8:8, which is shephatiah-10; shephatiah-5 is the EZR 2:4 namesake.
Same namesake problem as row 103364: the Shephatiah heading in EZR 8:8 is shephatiah-10. This is an agent row made on the owner's instruction, not a row the owner recorded himself.
The verse names Jeiel (Hebrew Yeiel), recorded as jeiel-10; jeuel-2 is the same man under a misspelled name and duplicates him.
Jozabad is a Levite here, so his father is the Levite Jeshua (jeshua-5, which owner row 105929 records); jeshua-3 is the EZR 2:2 namesake.
The father of Eleazar in EZR 8:33 is phinehas-3; 'phinehas' is Aaron's grandson, a different namesake.

missing.why: The verse lists Eliphelet, Jeiel and Shemaiah among the last sons of Adonikam, and no row records Jeiel's line.
The verse says 'the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi', a son-of statement that the site records only as descendant-of.

note: Read from the Hebrew: the 'sons of X: Y' headings are descendant-of and the 'son of' phrases son-of. Owner rows (105917, 106846, 107102, 105732, 105929, 107147) are not contested; 105730 uses companion-of, which is not in the type list, and its 'with him' is not a family statement, so it is kept.
